text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It happened a few days before
the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival
was to take place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Like hell I'd participate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There isn't a single Umamusume who doesn't participate in the Thanksgiving Festival.
Any Umamusume who has debuted is bound to have fans, and so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone participates actively, as it's a rare chance to show gratitude for the support they normally receive.
It's an event the fans look forward to very much as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "To manage race operations, appealing to spectators is essential. Therefore, host fan-oriented events at appropriate times to foster customer retention"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hearin' that makes a lot more sense.
Thanksgiving...? What the hell're we even givin' thanks for?
choice_data_list: Because there are girls who really draw strength from the fans' support.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And? I'm not like them.
It ain't gonna affect my running in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's all just noise anyway.
Let me focus on the race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has fans, too,
but unfortunately, their voices aren't reaching her right now.
She's shutting everything out across the board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet that's unlike her, who usually perceives the truth accurately.
She doesn't need to be grateful for their support,
but I at least want her to know it's there.
choice_data_list: Do you think they'll join us if we negotiate?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sitting at that table.
No matter how you slice it, there's no upside for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'd rather not stoop to bribery, but...
choice_data_list: A new "U-MAX226" is coming out, isn't it...?!
A new "U-MAX226" is coming out, isn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"U-MAX226" is a sneaker model that Air Shakur
loves to wear, and it's a wildly popular
line among younger kids.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm entering. And?
choice_data_list: It'll be displayed in stores instead.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...
And what if I say I don't want it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you want it, just draw the lottery.
Not like I need to negotiate with you, do I?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't go acting like you're already in checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well, fine.
I don't mind joining in.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Only if it's "just participating."
I ain't got any interest in entering competitions and being made a spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever.
Then it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're at the venue on the day,
there should be opportunities for the fans' voices to reach you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came the day of the Fan Appreciation Festival.
Air Shakur was..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sure is noisy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ain't goin'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, it took quite a bit of effort
to persuade Air Shakur."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I managed to get Air Shakur
to participate in the Fan Appreciation Festival...
or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Air Shakur...!
Didn't think she'd participate in an event like this.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~... That's crazy intense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given that they took the trouble to attend an event hosted by
Tracen Academy, most people are favorably inclined, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
I finally figured out what you're scheming.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In short, you're saying I need to psych myself back up, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"All they're throwing at me is hate.
That just makes it all the more fun."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it.
At the next Spring Tenno Sho... I'm gonna freak every single one of 'em out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back ahead of you. Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was the complete opposite of what I intended to convey, but perhaps this served to motivate Air Shakur even more.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Ah... They left.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I really should've called out to him...
But Shakur-san doesn't seem like the type
to appreciate that sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I really wanted to tell him
that I'll be rooting for him in the next Spring Tenno Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me.
Depending on the negotiations, that is."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Perfect. There's actually something I've been wanting to try out for a while now."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's that race where the Trainers run
on the schedule again this year, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"To clear my head, I used to make
menus for humans just for fun."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We haven't proven that yet, y'know...
Hey? Doesn't that sound like fun?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Your legs aren't lifting high enough!
That's useless training, so go do another 5 laps!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look. It's a Tracen Academy girl.
She's working so hard~, I wonder if she has a race coming up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're dropping back again.
You don't wanna do extra running, do you?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait... hold on.
Isn't the one running the Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after several days of training according
to the regimen Air Shakur put together—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: “—And it's off! The 1600m Trainer Sprint has begun!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer, who normally coaches Umamusume on their running,
musters all their knowledge to sprint
across the 1600m course!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final stretch!
Which Trainer will claim the victory—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? We have a Trainer making a furious chase here!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And she cuts down every last one of them in one fell swoop!
The winner is—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can get this even more precise...
If I start prepping for the next one now—”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...What's the point of thinking
about what comes next, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I managed to get Air Shakur
to participate in the Fan Appreciation Festival...
or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Air Shakur...!
Didn't think she'd participate in an event like this.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~... That's crazy intense.

text_block_list.text:

I finally figured out what you're scheming.

text_block_list.text: In short, you're saying I need to psych myself back up, right?

text_block_list.text:

That just makes it all the more fun."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it.
At the next Spring Tenno Sho... I'm gonna freak every single one of 'em out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back ahead of you. Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.text: Ah... They left.

text_block_list.text:
I really should've called out to him...
But Shakur-san doesn't seem like the type
